title: checklist-generator project settings
description: checklists.config.json at the root of a project: where its sources and pages live, and the defaults every checklist of the project shares. Every field is optional.

sources.description: Folder of the JSON sources, relative to this file. Default: checklists/sources.

output.description: Folder the HTML pages are written to, relative to this file. Default: checklists.

storage_prefix.description: Start of every page's browser storage key, so two projects' checklists never share ticks. Default: checklist-. Example: myapp-.

places.description: Step labels for the whole project, added to the built-in ones (and replacing one of the same key): { "pos": ["Shop till", "نقطة البيع"] }.

how_to.description: Replaces the standard "How to use this page" lines for every checklist of the project. A source's own how_to still wins.

fail_note.description: Replaces the standard "When a check fails" note for every checklist of the project. A source's own fail_note still wins.
